author: Fond
body:
I am Fond. I get salty during pvp when I get teamed on frequently, I personally enjoy gapple pvp and pot pvp but thought I'd try this server out because of all the different pings you need to fight against. I'll be around every now and again. Yes my username is OG no you cannot have it. I also go by 'Nokia', no you cannot have that one either. I look forward to meeting people in game to reduce my salt levels. 

Hobbies:
-Swimming
-Working out
-Collecting minecraft OG's
-Cracking a cold one with the boys

Favorite books:
lol who reads

Favorite TV show(s)
-The Simpsons
-Family Guy

Hoping to one day do an OG raid on this server with over 50+ og accounts for the memes, stare at all the basic names. 

=^.^= meow

replies.author: Fond
replies.body: Anytime. My personal preference for sniper is https://chearful.ninja/about.php he charges $5 per credit (1 credit = 1 snipe) and he seems to be the fastest sniper if multiple are sniping the same name. I sniped Nokia and many other names using it. You look on Name MC and use the availability checker to see if anyone has the name Queued. if they do not then you can spend a credit on it. All accounts being sniped must have no Security questions and you need to provide account email and password. Make a ticket with chearful if you have any further questions.
